# Laboratory Tests

This folder catalogs specific laboratory test codes and parameters used within the Danish healthcare system to monitor the quality of care for atrial fibrillation patients. Most of the identifiers map to thyrotropin (TSH) measurements required by AFDK Quality Indicator 3 to ensure proper diagnostic workups. Additionally, it includes codes and parameters for plasma and serum creatinine, which are tracked under Indikator 4b to mandate annual kidney function monitoring for patients on direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs). Together, these codes form the technical data extraction framework that bridges regional laboratory registries with national clinical quality audits.

## Pages

- [[as000646-p-thyrotropin|AS000646]] — Laboratory database code for p-thyrotropin (TSH) measurements, utilized in AFDK quality indicator 3.
- [[ass00039-p-thyrotropin|ASS00039]] — TSH measurement code recognized in the 2024 and 2025 AFDK reports for tracking indicator 3 compliance.
- [[ass00136-p-thyrotropin|ASS00136]] — Thyrotropin laboratory test code used to capture TSH measurements for atrial fibrillation quality indicator 3.
- [[ass00647-p-thyrotropin|ASS00647]] — Approved laboratory code for TSH measurement, used to evaluate diagnostic workups for atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[ass00650-p-thyrotropin|ASS00650]] — Specific database code for p-thyrotropin, added to the expanded 2025 AFDK code set for quality indicator 3.
- [[dnk35895-p-thyrotropin|DNK35895]] — TSH laboratory test code used in the 2024 and 2025 AFDK reports to define the numerator for indicator 3.
- [[epc00002-p-thyrotropin|EPC00002]] — Technical identifier for p-thyrotropin deployed in AFDK quality indicator 3 to extract relevant lab measurements.
- [[np03578-p-thyrotropin|NPU 03578]] — Valid laboratory code for TSH measurement that counts toward fulfilling atrial fibrillation indicator 3.
- [[np03624-p-thyrotropin|NPU03624]] — Foundational registry code for tracking thyrotropin (TSH) biomarker measurements in the AFDK quality program.
- [[np04199-p-thyrotropin|NPU04199]] — Designated code for TSH measurements used to calculate clinical quality indicator 3 in Danish health registries.
- [[np04200-p-thyrotropin|NPU04200]] — Laboratory test code identifying TSH measurements, ensuring comprehensive cardiovascular risk assessment for atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[npu03577-p-thyrotropin|NPU03577 (P-Thyrotropin)]] — Specific code used in the 2023 AFDK database to monitor TSH diagnostic follow-up within a strict clinical timeframe.
- [[npu04998-p-kreatinin|NPU04998 (P-Kreatinin)]] — Plasma creatinine code predominantly used in Region Hovedstaden and Region Sjælland to monitor kidney function for DOAC patients.
- [[npu18016-p-kreatinin|NPU18016 (P-Kreatinin)]] — Plasma creatinine code primarily utilized in Region Syddanmark and Region Nordjylland for annual renal function monitoring.
- [[npu27547-p-thyrotropin|NPU27547]] — LOINC-equivalent identifier for plasma thyrotropin used to track TSH measurements in AFDK quality indicator 3.
- [[p-creatinin|P-creatinin]] — Plasma creatinine laboratory parameter used in Indikator 4b to monitor renal function in patients on DOAC therapy.
- [[rsd03382-p-thyrotropin|RSD03382]] — Laboratory database code for p-thyrotropin, included in the 2025 AFDK technical definitions for quality indicator 3.
- [[s-creatinin|S-creatinin]] — Serum creatinine parameter tracked by Indikator 4b to ensure annual renal function monitoring for DOAC-treated patients.
